subject: The 2AM mistake that changed everything
preview_text: How one tap turned a forgetful night into an unforgettable memory. Your partner won't see it coming.
body_paragraphs: At 2AM last Tuesday, Sarah tapped a button she'd been ignoring for weeks. She was tired, out of ideas, and honestly, a little guilty about the last three dates that felt like meetings. One tap on 'cozy' later, her phone buzzed with a full-screen message from her partner: 'You thought of me tonight.' That single gesture, costing nothing but 30 seconds, broke a six-week streak of forgettable evenings.

This isn't about planning a perfect night. It's about the moment your partner sees that you saw them. The feature buried on your home screen, the one you probably scroll past, is the same one that turned Sarah's routine into a ritual. She stopped planning and started surprising. And her partner stopped feeling invisible.

That button is Tonight's Date. One tap on your mood, one tap send, and the AI does the rest. No scrolling, no debating, no fatigue. Just a thoughtful proposal your partner celebrates with a full-screen moment, not a bare notification. It's the difference between 'we should do something' and 'I already did.'

Open SoulPlan right now. Tap Tonight's Date. Pick a mood. Send it. Then watch what happens when your partner opens their phone. P.S. The first time you do this, you'll both remember it longer than any spreadsheet plan you've ever made.
